title: Step-Down: right hip fracture ORIF (POD 2) with a catheter-associated UTI
diagnosis: Right intertrochanteric hip fracture s/p ORIF, CAUTI, transfer to SNF
desc: 3 shifts on the Step-Down Unit (Tue 0700 to Wed 1500): post-operative care after hip ORIF, a catheter-associated UTI recognized by new confusion and fever, treated with ceftriaxone, then transfer to a skilled nursing facility.
